# WaystoneTravel

`world-system`

Fast travel between waystones: a player attunes to a stone by standing at it, then travels between two attuned stones for a cost in items per 1,000 km, once per cooldown.

> Make a planet that takes about 90 days to walk around navigable without removing the journey

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| rules | json | Travel rule: { stationType, attuneRadius (m), cooldownSeconds, costItem, costPerThousandKm, placementItem } (validated at fabric load) |

## Actions

### attune

Record that the player knows this waystone, by standing within the attune radius

**Conditions:**
- Host-validated; attunement is stored on the player record

### travel

Teleport between two attuned waystones, paying the item cost

**Conditions:**
- The player is within the attune radius of the departure stone and attuned to both
- Both stones still exist and the cooldown has elapsed
- The cost is paid from the inventory; a refusal tells the owner why
